name: Trace a claim to its original page
short_description: Trace a claim to its original page once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can trace a claim to its original page in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Trace a claim to its original page means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Trace a claim to its original page in a fresh real-life scenario.
